newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria identifies 13 new coal fields.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria identifies 13 new coal fields.

text.p: State-owned Nigerian Coal Corp (NCC) said on Thursday its data showed the presence of coal and lignite in 13 virgin fields spread across the country.
"(We are set) to reap maximum benefits whenever action is initiated to begin coal cropping in these virgin fields," said a statement from the NCC, reported by the News Agency of Nigeria.
It said the 13 mines would complement the existing four located in eastern Enugu and central Benue states, and which were currently being operated by the corporation.
Local and foreign joint venture partners to develop the coal mines were being sought and comprehensive data to determine viability of the coalfields were available, the statement added.
Nigeria's military government has since 1995 been reviving the coal corporation in a drive to diversify the nation's export income which is currently dominated by crude oil.
The first export of coal by NCC in many years was shipped in September to the Netherlands and the corporation says it already has orders for about 15 million tonnes.
Solid Minerals minister Kaloma Ali on Thursday at an African mining conference in South Africa urged foreign investors to exploit his country's coal reserves, which he put at 2.7 billion tonnes.
